This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the game [[Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia]] for the [[Nintendo DS]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Creatures, Inc.]] All names are given in Western order, with spelling according to the English game credits.
